newsitem.title: USA: Cincinnati Gas ends debt limiting provision.
newsitem.headline: Cincinnati Gas ends debt limiting provision.

text.p: The Cincinnati Gas & Electric Co said on Thursday it amended its articles of incorporation to remove a provision which limited its ability to issue unsecured debt, including short term debt.

Cinergy, the parent company and sole holder of Cincinnati Gas & Electric's common stock, also said in a statement it offered to buy outstanding preferred Cincinnati Gas & Electric shares. So far, about 85 percent of the two million outstanding preferred shares were tendered, it said.
The cash tender offer expired at 1700 EDT/2200 GMT, it said.
Cinergy said it voted all its shares in favor of the amendment to the articles of incorporation and that at least 70 percent of preferred stock was voted in favor.

Because the amendment was approved, Cincinnati Gas & Electric said it would make a special cash payment of $1 per share to each preferred holder who voted in favor of the amendment, if these shares were not tendered.
